venue.address: R. Tomás Alves de Figueiredo, 142 - Vila Hepacare, Lorena - SP, 12608-140, Brasil

items.information:
As inscrições encerrarão dia 08/02/2017, às 19h59, e custam R$10,00 + 1 kg de alimento não perecível (devendo ser levado no dia do campeonato). Após esse período, só será possível a inscrição na modalidade Rubik's Cube (3x3x3) no dia do campeonato.

É imprescindível ter lido as regras da WCA.

A entrada do público para assistir ao campeonato será mediante a entrega de 1 kg de alimento não perecível.

items.name: Bogor Open 2017

venue.name: Lippo Plaza Bogor
venue.address: Jl. Siliwangi No. 123, Sukasari, Kota Bogor

items.information: To celebrate the wave of new cubers and the rise of Rubik's Cube communities in Indonesia, Bogor Speedcubing Club will hold an official competition in February 11-12, 2017. Registration can be done by early bird (with special fee, please refer to our website) or on the spot. The registration will start from December 11, 2016. You can check the complete fees in our website  (http://bo2017.nsa.or.id/) please add your number in the comment section at registration. For more information please contact the organizers.
